key_insight: A SCAPS-1D plus machine-learning workflow can rapidly screen multilayer perovskite solar cells and pinpoint high-efficiency, lead-free double-perovskite architectures.
engineering_relevance: The study provides a practical optimization framework for selecting ETL/absorber/HTL combinations that improve power conversion efficiency while reducing the need for exhaustive simulations.
method: Trained an ML model on a representative subset to predict PCE for unseen structures.
Used SHAP to identify the most influential descriptors and verify top candidates with full device simulations.
evidence_signal: Leave-One-Group-Out cross-validation showed strong ranking performance via Spearman correlation, and the best verified devices reached 28.85% and 28.62% PCE.
watch_item: Predictions depend on the representativeness of the training subset and the fidelity of SCAPS-1D assumptions, so experimental validation is still needed before deployment.
paper_title: Multilayer Screening of Double and Conventional Perovskite Solar Cells Using SCAPS-1D and Machine Learning: Optimization of ETL, HTL, and Absorber for High-Efficiency Architectures
